title: What She Came To Ask
summary: The cliff where it began. She rides out of the sea-light to ask him a question with only one wrong answer, and he gives it. The first episode built on real two-shots.

scenes.visual: Very wide shot of a high green headland above a calm sea at golden hour, one ancient wind-bent tree at the cliff edge, long low light on the water. Nothing moves but the grass. Static camera.
Extreme wide shot. The warrior stands alone near the cliff edge, small in the frame, looking out to sea. Static camera.
Extreme wide shot. The princess stands at the far edge of the headland, small against the sea and the low sun. Static camera.

Wide two shot. The warrior and the princess stand a few paces apart on the same clifftop, both full length, facing each other, the sea behind them. The wind moves her hair and his cloak. Static camera.
Close shot. The princess's face in low gold light, wind moving her hair. She has already decided to ask. Static camera.

dialogue.line: I have watched you three days from the water and you have not once looked at the sea as though you wanted anything from it. Everyone wants something from the sea.

scenes.visual: Close shot. The warrior's face in low gold light, taking his time. Static camera.

dialogue.line: I have buried enough men to know what the sea gives back. I come up here to not want things. It is the only hour of the day I manage it.

scenes.visual: Wide two shot. The two of them on the clifftop, neither moving, the low sun between them and the water. Static camera.
Close shot. The warrior's face, low gold light, looking at her properly for the first time. Static camera.

dialogue.line: You have not told me what it costs. Everything I have ever been offered had a cost in it somewhere, usually near the end, usually said quietly.

scenes.visual: Close shot. The princess's face, steady, holding his eye. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Then I will ask you badly, because there is no good way. Come with me and you will not bury anyone again. Not your father, not your friends. Not ever.

scenes.visual: Close shot. The warrior's face. The offer has landed and he is not hiding it. Static camera.

dialogue.line: You have said the one thing I cannot argue with. I want you to know I heard the cost in it. I am going to say yes anyway, and I am going to say it quickly.

scenes.visual: Close shot. The princess's face. Relief, and something underneath it she does not say. Static camera.

dialogue.line: Quickly is how everyone says it. I have never once heard anyone take the time. That is not a complaint. It is only a thing I have noticed.

scenes.visual: Close shot. The princess's face. She does not look away, and she does not answer it either. Static camera.

dialogue.line: It costs you this. The hill, the sea from this side of it, and everyone who is standing on it. I am telling you that now and not near the end.

scenes.visual: Wide two shot. The two of them together on the clifftop, the sea and the low sun beyond, the wind-bent tree at the edge of frame. Static camera.
Extreme wide shot. The warrior stands alone at the cliff edge, small in the frame, looking back the way he came. Static camera.
Very wide shot of the empty clifftop at golden hour, the wind-bent tree alone at the edge, the sea beyond it. Nobody is there. Static camera.
